fsd_guidance_2021.title: Technical Guidance: Application of BS 5266-1:2016 and BS EN 1838:2013 for Emergency Lighting in Hong Kong
fsd_guidance_2021.applicability_note: Explicit project edition, FSD accommodation applicability and licensed-premises decision required. See docs/HK_EMERGENCY_LIGHTING.md.

rules.clause: Local modifications to BS 5266-1 clauses 5.2.2 and 5.2.6
rules.scope: Single accommodation, sourced whole-floor emergency illuminance through rated duration and distinct luminaire count; assertions only
rules.alternative_path_note: Supported accommodation condition fails; revise and review applicable emergency lighting requirements.

implemented: Sourced accommodation 2 lx minimum and >8 m2 two-luminaire condition
pending: Activation, duration selection, supplies, wiring, commissioning and maintenance
